mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_withdrawn = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO soldier_profile ( user_id, soldier_type, rank_name, enlistment_date, discharge_date, saving_join_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{soldierType}, #{rankName}, #{enlistmentDate}, #{dischargeDate}, #{savingJoinYn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE soldier_type = VALUES(soldier_type), rank_name = VALUES(rank_name), enlistment_date = VALUES(enlistment_date), discharge_date = VALUES(discharge_date), saving_join_yn = VALUES(saving_join_yn)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, soldier_type, rank_name, enlistment_date, discharge_date, saving_join_yn FROM soldier_profile WHERE enlistment_date IS NOT NULL AND discharge_date IS NOT NULL AND discharge_date >= CURDATE()
SELECT AVG(g.target_amount) FROM challenge_member cm JOIN goal g ON g.user_id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.group_id = #{groupId}
